opening.argument: The presentation links participation in mining with substantial projected financial growth. It states that placing 5,000 into a package could increase capital six to nine times over a year, while projecting that OneCoin could reach 50 to 100 euro in three years. The offer also ties its marketing plan to building a team and associates, and expressly connects commissions to partners who bought packages costing 500 EUR or more. These claims present OneCoin as an earning opportunity in which financial benefits depend on mining participation and qualifying purchases, supporting the conclusion that viewers are being urged toward paid package-based returns.
